scope: Clip speed on synthetic fixtures (frame-barcode video, sine tone). Sound is varispeed; pitch-preserving stretch and speed ramps are not implemented. Preview playback audio at speed is not measured here.

audio.method: zero crossings of the exported WAV mix; 440 Hz source tone of 4 s

checks.name: set_clip_speed 2: one transaction halves the clip (120 → 60 frames) and its linked sound together, source span unchanged
2×: the export has 60 frames and frame i shows source frame 2i — every frame read from its barcode
0.5×: the export has 240 frames and frame i shows source frame floor(i/2) (each source frame held for two)
1.5× (exact ratio 3/2): 80 frames, frame i shows source frame floor(3i/2); no drift at the end of the clip
split at timeline frame 30 of the 2× clip: the right half starts at source 2 s, keeps its speed, and the export is unchanged frame for frame
slowing a clip into its neighbour is refused with a clear error and changes nothing
a still render of timeline frame 45 shows source frame 90 (same evaluator as export)
undo: speed change and split were one transaction, so one undo returns to the single 1.5× clip of 80 frames
exported sound of a 440 Hz tone at 1×, 2×, 0.5×, 1.25×: pitch within 0.5 Hz of 440×speed and length within one frame of 4/speed (varispeed: pitch follows speed)
captions made from the transcript follow the speed: cues at 0–2 s and 2–4 s become 0–1 s and 1–2 s at 2×; a scene marker at source 3 s sits at 1.5 s
Inspector: the 2× preset commits set_clip_speed; the field shows 2 and the clip on the timeline is half as wide
preview: five seeks on the 2× clip each paint source frame 2×target; typing 0.75 stores the exact ratio 3/4 (160 frames); no page errors
